body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view (NOT a three-quarter angle, camera facing directly at the character), arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a human engineer wearing a hardhat, BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows fully straight, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso, both blocky hands fully visible in frame (not cropped at the image edge) with fingers spread, nothing held. Big oversized blocky head and a broad stocky short blocky body (chibi toy-figure proportions), made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, NO smooth curves -- each block face a single FLAT solid color with a bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky work-suit with thick gold trim blocks, a blocky gold hardhat block, blocky safety-goggles with two flat glowing TURQUOISE-CYAN rectangular lenses (turquoise blue-green color, absolutely not orange, not red, not yellow, not amber), a wrench block holstered flat on the belt, blocky boots. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, full body visible head to feet, generous empty margin on both sides so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark, no signature
